## About
California Air Conditioning Systems is a heating and air conditioning company on Narbonne Ave in Lomita, a few doors down from the Lomita Post Office. We install, repair and maintain HVAC systems for homes, businesses and industrial sites across the South Bay, Los Angeles County and Orange County.
Harry Irvine, our operations manager, is the name you'll see in our reviews. Customers also mention Jesus and Aidan from the team. We send texts and pictures as the work moves along, so you know what's happening with your system.
We work with brands like Carrier, Lennox, York, Cozy, Williams, Mitsubishi and Trane. Our neighbors give us a 4.6 rating from 219 Google reviews.

## Services
- HVAC Installations: New systems and full replacements for homes, commercial buildings and industrial facilities. We help you pick the system that fits your property, usage and budget.
- HVAC Preventative Maintenance: Our HVAC PM program: scheduled inspections and tune-ups that catch small problems before they turn into breakdowns and costly repairs.
- HVAC Repair Services: From faulty components and electrical issues to refrigerant leaks and thermostat malfunctions, our technicians find the root of the problem.
- Emergency Repair Services: Round-the-clock emergency availability, weekends included, for heating and air conditioning breakdowns.
- Emergency Heating Repairs: Gas furnaces, floor furnaces, heat pumps and other heating units, including evenings and weekends when the cold comes in after sunset.
- Chiller Repair Service & Installation: Repair, installation and preventative maintenance for commercial and industrial air cooled chillers.
- Cooling Towers Repair & Maintenance: Repair and maintenance for commercial and industrial cooling towers.
- Portable AC Rental: Portable air conditioning you can rent when you need cooling in a hurry.

## FAQ
Q: Can I call after hours?
A: Yes. Our phone lines are 24 hours. Call (310) 530-0504.

Q: What happens during a tune-up?
A: We do a detailed inspection that includes cleaning and replacing filters, checking refrigerant levels and inspecting electrical components, so every part is working the way it should.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We serve Southern California, including Los Angeles County, Orange County and the Beach Cities. Our listed service area includes Lomita, Torrance, Harbor City, San Pedro, Wilmington, Long Beach and Redondo Beach.

Q: How do I get a bid on a project?
A: Send the plans to Harry Irvine at harryirvine@californiaac.com.

Q: Where do I park if I stop by?
A: Park on the street or in the driveway, though driveway parking is temporary. We're a few doors down from the Lomita Post Office.
